messages:
Aisha Malik: Opening a whats-new draft for the upcoming runtime update (batching presets + KV cache tuning). PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991
Liam O'Connor: Thanks — can you drop the TL;DR bullets so I can proofread?
Aisha Malik: TL;DR: new batching presets (interactive-low-latency, throughput-balanced, cost-saver-v1); KV cache memory and prefix reuse improvements; routing prefers same-region endpoints for lower p99. Known issue: initial cache warmup can briefly underreport canary latency metrics.
Priya Rao: Add a short migration line: developers with custom batching should test presets in staging and enable via route config.
Liam O'Connor: I'll add the Python/TS SDK examples. Draft snippets: 
```
# Python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.routes.update('checkout-flow', batching_preset='interactive-low-latency')
```
```
// TypeScript
await client.routes.update('checkout-flow', { batchingPreset: 'interactive-low-latency' })
```
Aisha Malik: Great. Need one example for Dedicated customers to pin a preset at pool level and a note to restart long-lived workers.
Priya Rao: Suggested snippet for pools: `poolConfig: { batchingPreset: 'throughput-balanced' }` and callout: "Restart GPU workers or recycle processes to pick up new preset."
Marco Silva: For Known Issues, capture exact wording: "Enabling presets on legacy routes may cause temporary p50/p95 spikes for 1-3 minutes while continuous-batch windows and KV caches rebalance." Also link to incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2248
release-bot: Reminder: add a whats-new markdown under /docs/whats-new with frontmatter. Suggested frontmatter:
```
---
date: 2025-06-04
title: "Batching presets & KV cache optimizations"
components: [runtime, dedicated]
---
```
Liam O'Connor: I'll drop the SDK snippets into the PR and mark where the dedicated example should go. Priya, can you add the pool example and restart note?
Priya Rao: Done and pushed. Also added a short QA checklist: smoke test in staging, run p95/p99 ramp test, watch canary dashboard for 15 min.
Aisha Malik: Anyone object to merging after a quick editorial pass? If not, I'll merge and schedule the whats-new publish tomorrow 09:00 PST.
Marco Silva: No objections. Please ping eng-oncall for the first 30-60 minutes post-merge to monitor prefix warming.
Liam O'Connor: Tiny editorial nit — change "cost-saver-v1" to "cost-saver-1" for consistency with earlier names.
Aisha Malik: Updated. Merging after CI passes. Thanks team :rocket:
